parsed.rationale: Both `MockQualityClock` (Wallpaper package, `AdaptiveQualityControllerTests.swift`) and `MockClock` (Caching package, `CacheCoordinatorTests.swift`) are `type-alias-object` declarations living in separate test files across unrelated packages. Although the structural pipeline flags them as exact duplicates with `shared_field_count: 2`, the two aliases serve distinct domain purposes — one mocks a quality-aware clock for wallpaper adaptive-quality logic, the other mocks a generic cache-coordination clock — making their structural coincidence incidental rather than a sign of unintended duplication. Consolidating them into a shared target would couple two otherwise independent packages (`Wallpaper` and `Caching`) for no meaningful reuse gain, and the differing names already signal intentional domain separation.
